<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that breaks an O‑H bond (aliphatic hydroxyl) and forms an O‑Si bond, matching the protected alcohol SMILES provided.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "bonds_broken": ["O-H"],
    "bonds_formed": ["O-Si"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
